text: The initiative is the first parametric microinsurance in the Pacific, offering payouts within two weeks of verified disaster events. It focuses on inclusion, targeting women and persons with disabilities, and utilizes digital disbursement methods. The project is supported by a multi-donor and multi-country framework under PICAP, with local underwriting by FijiCare and Sun Insurance.
